description: LTX 2.3 video prompt validation rules. Swap this file for new LTX versions without code changes.

hard_blocks.description: Abstract emotion labels — LTX cannot interpret 'is sad'. Use physical cues instead.
hard_blocks.message_zh: 抽象情绪标签，请用身体线索替代（如「肩膀下垂，眼睛盯着地面」而非「很难过」）
hard_blocks.message_en: Abstract emotion label detected: use physical cues instead. e.g. 'shoulders slump, eyes fixed on floor' NOT 'looks sad'

hard_blocks.description: Text/logo descriptions — LTX cannot reliably render on-screen text.
hard_blocks.message_zh: 文本/Logo 描述，LTX 无法可靠渲染屏幕文字。请移除所有屏幕文字的引用。
hard_blocks.message_en: Text/logo description detected: LTX cannot reliably render text. Remove references to on-screen text, logos, signs, or written words.

soft_warnings.description: Complex physics (shatter/explode/fragment) likely produce visible artifacts.
soft_warnings.message_zh: 复杂物理效果（破碎/爆炸/碎片）可能产生可见伪影
soft_warnings.message_en: Complex physics described (shatter/explode/fragment): likely to produce visible artifacts in LTX output.

soft_warnings.description: >3 distinct characters may cause LTX quality degradation.
soft_warnings.message_zh: 角色数超过 3，LTX 可能难以处理多角色场景
soft_warnings.message_en: Character count exceeds 3: LTX may struggle with many distinct characters.

soft_warnings.description: LTX works best with 4-8 well-structured sentences (English only).
soft_warnings.message_zh: 英文提示词句数不在 4-8 推荐区间内
soft_warnings.message_en: Prompt sentence count outside 4-8 range: LTX works best with 4-8 well-structured sentences.

soft_warnings.description: Front light + backlight in same shot produces unnatural results.
soft_warnings.message_zh: 冲突光照：同时存在前光和逆光描述，可能产生不自然画面
soft_warnings.message_en: Conflicting lighting: both front light and backlight described. This can produce unnatural-looking results.
